content.text: Pherus Software is the open-source layer underneath everything else Pherus builds: developer tools, shared infrastructure, and the pieces that make the wider ecosystem possible.
Where Pherus publishes code, it's published in the open. See the Licenses page for exactly which terms cover which parts.
[This project is still being defined. Full details, features, and technology choices will be published here once there's something real to show.]
